messages:
anya: Heads up — planning to flip the region-fallback routing toggle for EU traffic at 15:00 UTC today. Goal: route to eu-2 when eu-1 crosses the 70% p99 CPU guardrail. Canary audience: 3% EU for 15m, then ramp to 20% if stable. Need ops window + quick rollback plan. ping @mike @cheng @leah
mike: SGTM. What's the exact flag id and PR? Also can you include the CLI toggle command for ops?
anya: Flag id: fw-region-fallback-eu. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/flags/pull/512 :eyes:
cheng: Two quick requests before prod flip: lower sticky_affinity.ttl to 10s during the canary, and cap max-burst to 2x so we don't overload eu-2 during ramp. Otherwise session stickiness will keep traffic on eu-1 and the test won't surface.
anya: Proposed flag payload (will add to PR):
```json
{
  "flag": "fw-region-fallback-eu",
  "enabled": true,
  "scope": "eu",
  "canary_pct": 3,
  "sticky_affinity": { "ttl_seconds": 10 },
  "max_burst_multiplier": 2,
  "fallback_region": "eu-2"
}
```
mike: also add an explicit kill-switch key we can toggle quickly, e.g. `fw-region-fallback-eu.override=false`. Post the exact CLI command for ops to cut the canary in half or zero.
leah: Monitoring checklist: EU p99 latency, per-region queue depth, model-fail-rate, and 5xxs. If p99 > 300ms or model-fail-rate > 0.5% for 5m -> immediate rollback. Also watch infra CPU and GPU queue times. I can run the checklist during the window.
oncall-bot: Ops window reserved: 14:50-15:30 UTC for eng-platform — contact ops-runner if you need to extend
sre-bot: Playbook: https://dash.redwood.ai/playbooks/region-fallback. Alerts created: EU-p99-latency > 300ms, EU-error-rate > 0.5%, EU-gpu-queue > 1s. Automated pager threshold set to 3m sustained.
anya: Rolling plan: 15:00 enable canary (3%) for 15m, 15:15 check metrics, 15:30 ramp to 20% over 10m if green. If any alert or manual :rotating_light: -> rollback to canary_pct=0 via CLI and set override=true for immediate stop.
mike: I'll own rollback and watch dashboards. CLI commands I'll use: 
```bash
# set to 0% quickly
redwood ff set fw-region-fallback-eu --canary_pct 0 --auth $OP_KEY
# full kill switch
redwood ff set fw-region-fallback-eu --override true --auth $OP_KEY
```
leah: I'll validate logs and traces, confirm no model degradation, and run internal smoke with header-based override (internal users only). ping me when you flip.
cheng: add header-based override for internal test users (`x-rw-internal: true`) so we can route 100% for smoke tests without affecting canary. Also confirm that sticky_affinity.ttl respects header override.
anya: Adding header override to PR now. Staging run for TTL/test now — will report back in 5m.
anya: Staging check at +5m: no anomalies, p99 stable, model-fail-rate 0.02%. Ready for prod flip at 15:00.
mike: go for it, I'm watching the dashboards.
sre-bot: Canary ramp started at 15:00 UTC for fw-region-fallback-eu (canary_pct=3) — dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/region-fallback/canary
anya: Noted. Will post a quick summary at +15m and after the ramp. If any of you want to be on the pager for the window say now.
mike: I'm on standby.
leah: on-call for traces, watching logs.
cheng: will monitor infra metrics and be ready to flip TTL back if we see excess rebalancing.
anya: Canary +15m: metrics look green. Proceeding to ramp to 20% over 10m.
anya: Ramp complete, no alerts fired. Closing loop and will keep guardrails in place for 24h. Adding a follow-up task to make the header-override explicit in the docs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
